meta.label: Best (EP-trained)
meta.description: Dense 2x256 tanh circular predictive-coding network for 4x4 Sudoku (6 givens), trained with centred equilibrium propagation (beta 0.2) on heavy-ball gradient-descent free phases; 87.7% of test boards solved.
meta.blurb: Trained with equilibrium propagation using exactly this GD inference; the best checkpoint by validation accuracy.

train.init: default initialisation; W1/W2 spectral norm pinned to the cap (exact SVD)
stabilisers: spectral cap of W1/W2 = 1.0 (pin, exact SVD, after every step)
per-puzzle early stop of the free phase at E < 1e-06
train.data: 4x4 Sudoku with 6 givens (4000 training / 1000 test puzzles) + per-batch symmetry augmentation
train.val_split: last 500 of the 4000 train puzzles (train on the first 3500)
train.note: the free phase in training = exactly meta.inference (per-puzzle early stop at E < tol)

search.rule: per rule: max success within K, prefer median steps in [2,4], then smaller lr; recommended rule: higher success, then fewer mean steps, ties -> one-sided

rho_J.note: spectral radius of the s -> s lap Jacobian W1 diag(1-u_hat^2) W2 diag(1-s_hat^2) at z_free, exact eigenvalues, first 128 test puzzles (all of them, converged or not)

tuning.criterion: max solved, then conv_frac, then fewer iterations

search.rule: per rule: max success within K, prefer median steps in [2,4], then smaller lr; recommended rule: higher success, then fewer mean steps, ties -> one-sided

rho_J.note: spectral radius of the s -> s lap Jacobian W1 diag(1-u_hat^2) W2 diag(1-s_hat^2) at z_free, exact eigenvalues, first 128 test puzzles (all of them, converged or not)

layout.convention: row vectors: y = x @ W + b; W stored as (in, out), C order
layout.x: x[5*cell + v] = 1 with v = puzzle value (0 blank, 1..4 digit), cell = 4*row + col; 80 inputs
layout.readout: logits_flat = s @ V + c (64); logits[cell][d] = logits_flat[4*cell + d]; digit = d + 1
layout.cost: C = mean over the 16 cells of -log_softmax(logits[cell])[label[cell]]; label = solution - 1
layout.init_ff: u0 = tanh(b1) (= u_hat(s = 0)); s0 = tanh(u0 @ W2 + b2 + x_inj)
layout.gd: while t < T_free and E(z) >= tol: v = mom*v - eta*dE/dz; z = z + v; t += 1  (v0 = 0)
layout.grad_z: e_u = u - u_hat, e_s = s - s_hat, d_u = e_u*(1-u_hat^2), d_s = e_s*(1-s_hat^2); dE/du = e_u - d_s @ W2^T; dE/ds = e_s - d_u @ W1^T
layout.nudge: from z_free, v = 0, T_nudge times: v = mom*v - eta*(dE/dz + beta*dC/dz); z = z + v
layout.theta_grad: dE/dW1 = -outer(s, d_u), dE/db1 = -d_u, dE/dW2 = -outer(u, d_s), dE/db2 = -d_s, dE/dWin = -outer(x, d_s), dE/dbin = -d_s
layout.ep_one_sided: g_theta = (dE/dtheta(z_plus) - dE/dtheta(z_free)) / beta; g_psi = dC/dpsi(z_free); theta -= lr*g_theta; psi -= lr_readout*g_psi
layout.b64: base64 of little-endian float32, C order; per-sample shapes (no batch dimension)
